links.comparator_used: Radiologists interpreting thyroid nodules without AI assistance (same radiologists, three guidelines)
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and FNA decision making for intermediate suspicion thyroid nodules
links.effect: Radiologists' accuracy rose from 66.4%-71.4% without AI to 74.1%-79.4% with AI (P < .001). FNA rates fell by 20.3%-34.7%, malignant detection rose by 15.0%-23.4%, and missed malignancy fell by 23.7%-36.8% (all P < .001).
links.quote: AI assistance reduced FNA rates by 20.3% to 34.7%, increased malignant detection rate by 15.0% to 23.4%, and decreased missed malignancy rate by 23.7% to 36.8% (all P < .001).

design_hint: AI assistance for radiologist interpretation and FNA decisions
